description: This file defines the Control class for map controls in the Leaflet library, including methods for positioning, adding, and removing controls from a map, as well as extending map functionalities to manage controls.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Base class for implementing map controls, handling positioning and lifecycle management.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the control on the map.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the control on the map.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the HTML element containing the control.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Adds the control to a specified map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the control from the current map.

methods.name: _refocusOnMap
methods.description: Refocuses the map container if a non-keyboard event occurs.
